in_sanskrit.name: कैरव
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who moves or flows with tears
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'Kri' meaning to cry, and 'Rav' meaning to move or flow.

in_marathi.name: Kairav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kairav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kairava’, which is a type of tree. In Hindu mythology, Kairav is the name of a tree under which Lord Krishna played as a child, spreading joy and happiness. It is also believed that touching or seeing a Kairav tree brings joy and happiness.

in_bengali.name: Kairav

It is also believed that touching or seeing a Kairav tree brings joy and happiness.
